# TinyStudio.io

TinyStudio.io sells a human-reviewed leak audit and Growth Desk for high-ticket businesses.

Canonical URL: https://tinystudio.io/
Contact: hello@tinystudio.io

## Current Product: The Leak Audit And Growth Desk

The audit is free. TinyStudio reads the one page a business's revenue depends on the way a customer with intent reads it, and shows the exact points at which that customer leaves. If the business wants the leaks closed rather than merely found, the Growth Desk does the work. The whole surface is human-reviewed: a person reads and signs every client-facing output.

Intake takes about thirty seconds: a website and an email. No call is required at any point. Six a month. When the sixth is taken, the intake closes until the next month. Findings are delivered inside five working days and are yours to keep, whether or not TinyStudio ever hears from you again.

### The Leak Audit

Four passes, by hand, on the surfaces that decide whether someone who arrived ready to buy stays that way:

- The money page — the one page revenue depends on, and the precise points at which a customer with intent loses interest
- The paid creative — the top spend, checked for genuinely distinct concepts rather than one idea wearing ten hooks
- The unanswered — the questions people need settled before they commit, and whether the site settles a single one of them
- The reach — whether new work is reaching new people or quietly re-serving the audience already held

The deliverable is a short, plain document: named leaks in the order they cost the business money, with the fix beside each one. No deck, no dashboard, no jargon. Most of what is found is fixable by a competent developer in an afternoon, including one who is not TinyStudio. A specimen of a real audit is published with the client name withheld.

### The Growth Desk

If the work is wanted done, the desk runs at $2,500 per month on a three-month minimum:

- Month one — the leak audit, then the highest-leverage page rewritten or rebuilt, a dev-ready handoff if the client's own team ships it, and search-trust basics: the questions people ask before they commit, answered on the page
- Months two and three — weekly checks, one revision, and tracking that tells the client whether the fix held

Delivery guarantee: if the month-one deliverables are not in the client's hands within fourteen working days of Day 0, month one is refunded in full. Day 0 begins only once payment, access, the approval owner, and the implementation owner are all recorded. If TinyStudio is waiting on the client, the clock pauses. This is the only promise made about outcomes, and it is a promise about the work, not the client's market.

## Who Does The Work

Seven specialists sit behind the desk, each with a single job, a fixed set of inputs, and a checklist it must satisfy: Landing Page Fixer, Product Page Fixer, Site Architecture Fixer, Ad Angle Generator, Competitor Watcher, Email & SMS Generator, and Weekly Performance Analyst. They read the client's actual pages, reviews, ads, and numbers, and the competitors around them; they flag every claim that needs proof before it can be said; they run on the current frontier model tier, chosen per job. Automation never gets the last word: fit, claims, client-facing work, delivery, and renewal are all human decisions, and every client-facing output carries one human signature.

## What It Is Never Allowed To Do

- Send anything to anyone
- Publish anything to a client's site
- Spend ad budget
- Approve, accept, or renew its own work
- Connect to ad accounts, change ad spend, or publish campaigns without human approval

No campaign publishing. No ad spend changes. Claims, ad spend, campaign publishing, platform connections, CRM outcome syncing, and compliance-sensitive decisions remain approval-gated.

## What It Does Not Promise

TinyStudio does not promise revenue, ROAS, profit, booked calls, rankings, AI visibility, conversion lift, or sales lift, and guarantees nothing about what the market does with better work. No revenue, ranking, ROAS, conversion, booked-call, or sales-volume guarantees. The delivery guarantee above is the only promise made about outcomes.

## Evidence

- The audit's market finding is backed by a continuously refreshed study: an automated read of the served homepage HTML, refreshed daily, of public high-ticket homepages. As of the latest snapshot, 99 sites were attempted across 13 industries and 8 geographies; 89 were readable and 10 were blocked by bot protection and excluded from every count. 53 of the readable 89 answer none of the questions a buyer asks before committing, and 57 show no price. Inner pages are deliberately not counted — the finding is about the homepage.
- The AI-search reach pass publishes its evidence on the audit page: a controlled test on TinyStudio's own site, with the exact prompts, the verbatim answers, and the pages each engine cited embedded, and every answer labelled found, wrong, absent, or not tested. It is a record of one day on one set of engines and changes when the evidence changes; nothing in it is a promise of ranking, leads, or visibility.
- Client work is never published: no logos, no case studies, no testimonials, no "as seen at". Market research is the opposite and is shared freely; anything belonging to someone who paid TinyStudio is never shared.

## Data Handling

The public app stores email signup and lightweight usage metadata in Cloudflare D1. The email_signups table stores the email, normalized website, source, page path, referer, and user agent. The agent_usage_limits table stores daily rate-limit counters, including a daily hashed IP-derived rate-limit key. The agent_runs table stores email, source, page path, a hashed IP, and user agent for agent runs.

The business snapshot, optional details, weekly metrics, and generated artifacts submitted to the self-serve drafting desk are processed to generate the output and are not stored by this app. Client-side code does not call model providers, platform admin APIs, ad accounts, databases, or private credentials directly; generation runs server-side through Cloudflare Workers AI.

There is no public endpoint for reading collected emails or usage metadata.

## Other Served Surfaces

A self-serve drafting desk remains served at /agent-desk for pipeline planning drafts (Pipeline Brief, Implementation Checklist, Weekly Fix Report). It is not the current public product: it drafts planning assets only, under the same approval gates and storage limits described above. The retired app.tinystudio.io and api.tinystudio.io hosts return intentional retired responses.
